name: Fanuc lathe
description: Millimetre Fanuc lathe dialect, G-code system A. Percent-delimited program O0001 with sequence numbers. Diameter mode is the control default, so no G7 is written. G21 selects millimetres, G40 cancels tool-nose compensation and G80 cancels a canned cycle. The ZX plane is G18 and feed per minute is G98. G99 is left out: the IR feed is millimetres per minute. G90 is left out: on this control it is an outer and inner diameter cutting cycle, and X and Z are already absolute. Constant surface speed is G50 S max-rpm, then G96 S metres per minute. Direct rpm is G97. The spindle is M3, M4 or M5. The tool word is the tool and offset in two digits (T0101). Arcs are I and K, I a radius. Single-point threading is G32 with the lead on F. Home is G28 U0 W0, a reference return, not a part move. The program ends with M30 and %. No rotary axis.
